Round the catalogue Brougham lamp housings, repair the planted horse eye UV mapping, and add a safe Western Hotel yard viewpoint. The horse placement and mechanics stay unchanged.

- **T-3083:** V18 lamps use rounded upper housings and narrower lower bodies. Near/mid exports preserve non-lamp geometry, materials, nodes, contacts, collision proxy and runtime policies. V17 production and qualification history is archived.
- **T-3086:** the separately versioned `d4544c28` eye derivative reproduces from canonical `b479`, changing the declared eye UVs, bounds and derivative notice. Geometry, rig, weights, animation, materials and all six embedded images are preserved.
- **T-3087:** adds the camera at E−124/N−292/yaw221.19. All 19 viewpoints are dry and outside roofs; the previous 18 and actor placement are unchanged. Shared licence, liberty, STATUS and ROADMAP metadata records the group once.

The historical V17 liberty decision remains intact with an appended V18 amendment. The original ROADMAP bytes and incoming Glessner records/bakes are preserved. This increment leaves photographic/native/world qualification, gait, tack, teams, occupants and riding open under the existing remainder tickets; parents T-2794/T-2800 remain split.

Validated source head: `3290195d40cbacf5cbfd0c76f14119d6712aa30c`, tree `bac89999d2afd653e632c52d15b2f50336688deb`. Local complete preflight passed **1,063 steps**, including **383 negative self-tests**, in 665.888 seconds. The committed-head changelog and ticket-ID checks passed. The canonical derived tail passed 59 steps in one unchanged lap. All 59 source file hashes stayed unchanged; process cleanup completed with zero owned children remaining. Independent lamp boundary/LOD, UV boundary/reproduction and anchor checks passed; root inspected the saved CPU comparisons. Those comparisons do not establish photographic or native PBR acceptance.

Published browser smoke is in progress across all 15 stages and both viewports. Mobile stages 1–6 passed with zero page errors; remaining coverage is pending. The normal moving-frames run failed during **Install Playwright**, before publishing or running any renderer measurements. Installation diagnosis is in progress; official job-log redirects currently hit a proxy CONNECT denial. The normal PR gate is still running, while the source push report and warranted build screen passed. This PR stays draft until required browser coverage is complete and fresh required CI checks are green. No DEV merge or public delivery is claimed.

Full source manifests, preservation audits and preflight logs: [evidence checkpoint 6](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/e0acf6a7e012f70885b0dcb5e98d946073ff22d3/evidence/transport-recovery-2026-10-24/CHECKPOINT-6-INTEGRATED-PREFLIGHT-PASS).
